rationale: C02 is the immediately preceding postponement of the same Panama Canal toll proclamation and supplies nearly the entire child’s drafting structure and much of its exact language. The child updates the prior effective date from September 1, 1949, to April 1, 1950, while retaining the statutory recital, history of the original toll proclamation, public-interest finding, and operative formula declaring that its effective date is “further postponed to, and shall be” the new date. C08 is an earlier version of the same postponement template, while C04 is chiefly the underlying toll-setting proclamation rather than the source of the postponement machinery.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Whereas section 411 of title 2 of the Canal Zone Code, approved June 19, 1934, authorizes the President to prescribe and from time to time change the tolls ... and provides that no tolls when so prescribed shall be changed unless six months' notice thereof is given by the President by proclamation
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Whereas section 411 of title 2 of the Canal Zone Code, approved June 19, 1934, authorizes the President to prescribe and from time to time change the tolls ... and provides that no tolls when so prescribed shall be changed unless six months' notice thereof is given by the President by proclamation
shared_material.explanation: The statutory-authority recital is reproduced essentially verbatim.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Whereas increased tolls for the use of the Panama Canal were prescribed by [DIRECTIVE_REFERENCE] of March 26, 1948, the said proclamation to become effective on October 1, 1948
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Whereas INCREASED TOLLS FOR THE USE OF THE Panama Canal were prescribed by [DIRECTIVE_REFERENCE] of March 26, 1948, the said proclamation to become effective on October 1, 1948
shared_material.explanation: The child repeats C02’s identification and effective-date history of the underlying proclamation.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Whereas the effective date of the said [DIRECTIVE_REFERENCE] was thereafter postponed until September 1, 1949
shared_material.parent_excerpt: the effective date of the said [DIRECTIVE_REFERENCE] ... is further postponed to, and shall be, September 1, 1949
shared_material.explanation: The child incorporates the operative result of C02 as the next link in the postponement history.

shared_material.child_excerpt: acting under and do hereby proclaim that the effective date of the said [DIRECTIVE_REFERENCE] of March 26, 1948, is further postponed to, and shall be, April 1, 1950
shared_material.parent_excerpt: acting under and do hereby proclaim that the effective date of the said [DIRECTIVE_REFERENCE] of March 26, 1948, is further postponed to, and shall be, September 1, 1949
shared_material.explanation: The operative clause is copied almost word for word, with only the newly selected effective date substituted.
